prerequisites: L3 Mécanique S5: Beam theory course

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to model mechanical structures from a geometric point of view and with boundary conditions.
Master the consequences of modeling assumptions on the results of finite element calculations.

syllabus_topics: Equation formulation in the case of a finite element problem
Application of the finite element method to the 1D problem: bar in tension-compression and beam in bending
Equation formulation and static resolution of a truss or frame
Definition of stiffness, mass matrices and generalized force vectors
Presentation of 2D and 3D volumetric finite elements
Calculation of structural behavior using finite element software (2D and 3D models) from a simple but real problem
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
